title: I02 En-Route Welfare Log Entry (bound event)
description: A signed journey event bound to the I01 anchor and hash-linked to the previous event. Sensor streams are not credentials: temperature is summarised here, the raw Tier-2 data stay in tamper-protected storage and are referenced by digest.

x-traced.status: pre-project draft — subject to change in T4.1
x-traced.issuer: Transporter (driver device, on behalf of the transporter — Annex II, Section 4); official-check events are signed by the checking official veterinarian or authority.
x-traced.holder: Transporter; synchronised progressively to the platform.
verifiers: Competent authority of destination and departure
legalBasis: Reg (EC) No 1/2005 Annex I, Chapter V (intervals, journey times, rest)
Reg (EC) No 1/2005 Art. 6(9) and Annex I, Chapter VI, point 4 (navigation system)
Reg (EC) No 1255/97 Art. 6 (fitness to continue confirmed on the journey log at control posts)
x-traced.forwardCompatibility: COM(2023) 770 (proposal) — forward-compatibility only: journey records in TRACES; mapping in T2.1.
x-traced.revocation: Not revoked; corrections are new events.
x-traced.integrity: Signed event; hash-linked; Tier-2 sensor data by digest.
useCases: UC-3 official verification at control points
openQuestions: Granularity: one event per stop vs. periodic welfare summaries.

previousEventDigest.description: Digest of the previous event (or of the anchor for the first event).

location.description: Where the event occurred. Driver geolocation is personal data: country is always disclosed, coordinates only when the check requires them.

fitToContinue.description: Official-check and control-post events: animals confirmed fit to continue.

sensorEvidenceDigest.description: Digest of the Tier-2 sensor/telematics records covering the event.

reference.description: A01 number, H03 professionalId or authority name.
